Strings and regular expressions (regex)

string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "jeff")

str_detect(string_vec, "jeff")
## [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE
str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
## [1] "My"   "name" "is"   "jeff"
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "i think")
## [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE
str_detect(string_vec, "^i think") # ^ indicates beginning of line
## [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE
str_detect(string_vec, "i think$") # $ indicates end of line
## [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec,"[Pp]umpkin") #[] either of these will work
## [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "^[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
## [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11") # . matches everything
## [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[")
## [1]  TRUE FALSE  TRUE  TRUE

quick note on factors

vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))

as.numeric(vec_sex)
## [1] 2 2 1 1
vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male")

Import NSDUH

url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html =
  read_html(url)

Pull the table out

marj_df =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1) |> 
  select(-contains ("P Value")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    -State,
    names_to = "age_year",
    values_to = "prev"
  ) |> 
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |> 
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""),
    prev = str_replace(prev, "[a-c]", ""),
    prev = as.numeric(prev)
  )

make a quick plot

marj_df |> 
  filter(age == "12-17") |> 
  mutate(State = fct_reorder(State, prev)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = State, y = prev, color = year)) + 
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

NYC Airbnb

data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(
    neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan",
    price < 1000) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

Restaurant inspections

data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |> 
  rename(borough = boro)

Quick EDA

rest_inspec = 
  rest_inspec |> 
  filter(
    borough != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  )
rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   borough           A     B     C
##   <chr>         <int> <int> <int>
## 1 Bronx         14071  2611   976
## 2 Brooklyn      38896  6423  2194
## 3 Manhattan     61675  9107  3600
## 4 Queens        36258  5526  1996
## 5 Staten Island  5410   855   248

Look for pizza places

rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "Pizza")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 4 × 3
##   borough       A     B
##   <chr>     <int> <int>
## 1 Bronx        15     3
## 2 Brooklyn     15    NA
## 3 Manhattan    13     3
## 4 Queens       11     4

This is better

rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "[Pp][Ii][Zz][Zz][Aa]")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   borough           A     B     C
##   <chr>         <int> <int> <int>
## 1 Bronx          1201   261    98
## 2 Brooklyn       1919   291    95
## 3 Manhattan      2091   400    96
## 4 Queens         1695   239    78
## 5 Staten Island   328    60    15

Alternative

rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   borough           A     B     C
##   <chr>         <int> <int> <int>
## 1 Bronx          1201   261    98
## 2 Brooklyn       1919   291    95
## 3 Manhattan      2091   400    96
## 4 Queens         1695   239    78
## 5 Staten Island   328    60    15
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) +
  geom_bar()

rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(
    dba = str_to_upper(dba),
    borough = fct_infreq(borough),
    borough = fct_recode(borough, "The City" = "Manhattan")) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade)) +
  geom_bar()
